meta.goal: Strong, lean and fit. Moderate loads, perfect form, a healthy spine.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.focus: Learn the movements and find your starting weights. Everything light and smooth — you should finish every set feeling like you had 3-4 more reps in you.

blocks.name: Build
blocks.focus: Moderate weights, tight form. Add reps first, then take the smallest weight step up. Two reps in the tank on every set.

blocks.name: Strong
blocks.focus: A touch heavier, never a grind. If a weight forces you to brace hard or hold your breath, it is too heavy — drop back and own the reps. Week 12 is lighter: 2 sets, enjoy it, then start the next cycle.

warmup.name: Easy treadmill walk
warmup.note: Get blood moving before you touch a weight

warmup.name: Cat-cow
warmup.note: Gentle, only in a pain-free range

warmup.name: Glute bridge
warmup.note: Squeeze at the top, ribs down

warmup.name: First exercise, feather-light
warmup.note: Half the weight, full reps, groove the pattern

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Feet flat, shoulder blades tucked, only your natural arch. Lower to chest level under control.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Back pad upright, neutral grip, ribs down. Press without arching the low back.
exercises.spine: Keep this light. Overhead work loads the spine — the back pad does the bracing for you.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.cue: Slight elbow bend, squeeze hands together at the middle, torso perfectly still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Light. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height, no swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cue: Rope or bar, elbows pinned to your sides, full lockout, stand tall.

core.name: Dead Bug
core.cue: Low back pressed into the floor the whole time. Slow.

core.name: Cable Pallof Press
core.cue: Cable at chest height, press out and hold 2s. Resist the twist.

treadmill.name: Apple Fitness+ Treadmill
treadmill.note: Pick any 20-minute Treadmill workout. Mostly easy-to-moderate effort (Z2-Z3) — you just lifted.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Dumbbell held at the chest keeps your torso tall. Sit between your hips, only as deep as feels good. Box behind you is fine.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: Step back, front shin vertical, chest tall. Hold the rack if you need balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: LIGHT. Soft knees, hinge at the hips, dumbbells slide down your thighs. Stop the moment your hamstrings tug — never let your back round.
exercises.spine: The one hinge in the plan. If your back says anything at all, swap to the hip thrust — same muscles, spine supported.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.cue: Ankle strap, hold the frame, kick back with the glute — no arching to cheat range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Toes on a plate or step, full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

core.name: Side Plank
core.cue: From knees if needed. Hips stacked and lifted, straight line.

core.name: Bird Dog
core.cue: Reach long, hold 2s, hips stay level. The best spine exercise there is.

treadmill.name: Apple Fitness+ Treadmill
treadmill.note: Legs are already worked — choose a walking / hiking-style Treadmill session. Incline up, impact down.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Chest tall, pull the elbows down to your ribs, small lean only. Control the way up.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.cue: Tall spine, pull to your belly button, shoulders back. No rocking your torso.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.cue: Incline bench at 30-45°, chest on the pad so your spine is fully supported. Row to your hips.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.cue: Rope at face height, pull toward your forehead with elbows high. Posture gold.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: Elbows still, no swinging, squeeze at the top.

core.name: Front Plank
core.cue: Squeeze glutes, ribs down, breathe. Stop before your hips sag.

core.name: Suitcase Carry
core.cue: One light-moderate dumbbell, walk tall and don't lean. Anti-side-bend for the spine.

treadmill.name: Apple Fitness+ Treadmill
treadmill.note: Your one harder cardio of the week. A Treadmill workout with run pushes; hit Z3-Z4 on the pushes, walk the recoveries.

options.name: Apple Fitness+ HIIT
options.note: Choose the low-impact modifier when it's offered. No burpees you don't want to do.

options.name: Apple Fitness+ Cycling
options.note: Easiest on the spine. Bike or spin bike at home.

options.name: Apple Fitness+ Rowing
options.note: Only if you row with a tall neutral back — skip if it bugs you.

options.name: Apple Fitness+ Dance or Kickboxing
options.note: Fun beats optimal. Full-body, gets the heart rate up.

options.name: Outdoor Walk / Run
options.note: Time to Walk or Time to Run. Fresh air counts.

core.name: Apple Fitness+ Core
core.note: Do this right after the cardio. Modify: skip sit-ups, V-ups, Russian twists and weighted crunches — swap in dead bugs, planks or bird dogs for those sections.

cooldown.name: Apple Fitness+ Mindful Cooldown or Yoga
cooldown.note: Optional. Skip deep backbends; hips and hamstrings are the priority.

rest.name: Rest / Walk
rest.note: 20-30 min easy walk if you can. Optional 10-min Apple Fitness+ Yoga or Mindful Cooldown. Lean happens with daily movement, not just gym days.

rules: Double progression: pick a weight, work up to the top of the rep range on every set, then take the smallest step up and start again at the bottom of the range.
Reps first, weight second. Adding a rep at the same weight is progress.
Every set should end with 2-3 reps still in the tank (RPE 6-8). Nothing in this plan is meant to be a max.

spine: Neutral spine on every rep. If you have to round or arch to move the weight, the weight is too heavy.
Moderate loads only: you should never need to hold your breath and brace hard. Dumbbells and cables, nothing overhead heavy, no barbell.
Prefer supported positions: seated with a back pad, chest on a bench, hand on a bench.
Skip these for good: sit-ups, crunches, V-ups, Russian twists, back extensions / supermans, good mornings, heavy deadlifts, loaded twisting.
Progress by reps first, then the smallest weight step — 5 lb on dumbbells, one plate on cables.
Warm up every time. Two minutes walking before you lift is non-negotiable.
Sharp pain, numbness or tingling down a leg means stop that exercise for the day and swap to the alternative. Check in with your doctor or PT if it repeats.
